task_details.question: Find the total revenue generated by each genre name, sorted by revenue descending.

Zero Context.sql_query: SELECT genre_name, SUM(sales) FROM genre_sales GROUP BY genre_name;

Raw DDL.sql_query:
SELECT g.name, SUM(ii.unit_price * ii.quantity) AS total_revenue
            FROM genres g
            JOIN tracks t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id
            JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.track_id = ii.track_id
            GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name
            ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

Schemap.sql_query:
SELECT g.name, SUM(ii.unit_price * ii.quantity) AS total_revenue
            FROM genres g
            JOIN tracks t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id
            JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.track_id = ii.track_id
            GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name
            ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

task_details.question: List the top 5 customers by total invoice spending along with their support representative's first and last name.

Zero Context.sql_query: SELECT c.name, e.rep_name, SUM(i.amount) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.id = i.customer_id JOIN employees e ON c.rep_id = e.id GROUP BY c.id;

task_details.question: Find the top 3 product names by total sales revenue from order details (unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)).

Zero Context.sql_query: SELECT product_name, SUM(price * qty) FROM sales_items GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3;

Raw DDL.sql_query:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1.0 - od.discount)) AS total_sales
            FROM order_details od
            JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
            GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
            ORDER BY total_sales DESC
            LIMIT 3;

task_details.question: Find the top 5 actor full names who have appeared in the most 'Action' category films.

Zero Context.sql_query: SELECT actor_name, count(*) FROM movies WHERE category = 'Action' GROUP BY actor_name;

Raw DDL.sql_query:
SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(f.film_id) AS action_film_count
                FROM actor a
                JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
                JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
                JOIN category_film fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
                JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
                WHERE c.name = 'Action'
                GROUP BY a.actor_id;

Schemap.sql_query:
SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(f.film_id) AS action_film_count
            FROM actor a
            JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
            JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
            JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
            JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
            WHERE c.name = 'Action'
            GROUP BY a.actor_id
            ORDER BY action_film_count DESC
            LIMIT 5;
